note: Adapted from Bacchus's (1997) original description (in English) when the species was described; the alate, soldier and major worker all have prose descriptions and measurement tables. The author groups the alate and soldier of this species with those of redenianus and luteus, from which it is distinguished by the longer head and the longer hind tibia; the worker is grouped with those of luteus, lokoriensis and redenianus. The 16-segmented alate antennae are among the more numerous in the genus.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head orange, with many yellow dots of various sizes scattered at the hair bases; frons paler; postclypeus and labrum yellow; anteclypeus yellow-white; antennae yellow with brownish sides, segment 1 brown; pronotum yellow; body, femora, tibiae and tarsi yellow, slightly darker than the abdomen. Wings pale yellow, the costa darker. Posterior margin of the head capsule arcuate and evenly rounded; hairs above and behind the compound eyes numerous but not extending beyond the outer convexity of the compound eyes; frontal gland pore absent; median spot oval and vague; the V-shaped part of the cranial suture present; frons smooth. Posterior margin of the postclypeus arcuate, the median suture moderately distinct. Compound eyes almost circular; ocelli short-oval and not touching the compound eyes. Labrum shorter than wide. Antennae 16-segmented, segments 3 to 5 similar in size, segments 1 and 2 about equal. Pronotum hairy, the anterior margin undulate and the posterior margin moderately concave; posterior margin of the meso- and metanota shallowly V-shaped.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule and labrum yellow to orange; mandibles brown to red-brown with a yellow base; antennae, body and legs pale yellow to yellow; postmentum concolorous with the head, not darker than the cheeks. Head capsule long-oval, widest behind and narrowing near the antennal fossae; short hairs numerous on the sides, long hairs fewer; antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 similar, segments 1 and 2 about equal; labrum broadly tongue-shaped, with 8—10 hairs in the anterior third; mandibles moderately stout, the tip strongly incurved, the degree of curvature 0.06—0.08 mm; postmentum distinctly longer than wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, both lobes hairy, the anterior lobes separated by a moderately deep V-shaped median notch, the posterior lobe large and semicircular with a slightly concave margin. Fore tibia very swollen; spurs 3, the dorsal spur just beyond half the length of the outer ventral spur; the single long hair on the fore coxa not spine-like.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head capsule pale orange, body, legs and antennae yellow. Head capsule almost square, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broad and evenly rounded; sides with many hairs of various lengths. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 the shortest, segment 3 slightly smaller than segment 5; postclypeus inflated and lenticular, the median suture moderately distinct; anteclypeus flat, projecting forwards in the middle; only the V-shaped part of the cranial suture visible; labrum with a transverse sclerotized band, the tip broadly rounded. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior and posterior margins slightly concave. Fore tibia not swollen; spurs 3, the dorsal spur about half the length of the outer ventral spur; a large hair on the front of the fore coxa almost spine-like.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate measurements (2 specimens, 1 colony, mm): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.28—1.30, head width including the compound eyes 1.43—1.48, postclypeus length 0.28—0.30 and width 0.58, labrum length 0.38 and width 0.53—0.55, greatest compound eye diameter 0.45 and least diameter 0.43, greatest ocellus diameter 0.23—0.25 and least diameter 0.18—0.20, ocellus-to-compound-eye distance 0.04, pronotum length 0.88—0.90 and width 1.35—1.38, hind tibia length 1.60. Soldier measurements (13 specimens, 7 colonies): head including the mandibles 1.48—1.60, head length to the base of the mandibles 0.95—1.05, head width behind the antennal fossae 0.78—0.88, greatest head width 0.80—0.90, labrum length 0.30—0.33 and width 0.20—0.28, left mandible transverse length 0.58—0.60, width 0.06—0.07, curvature 0.06—0.08, fore tibia length 0.60—0.63 and width 0.15—0.18, hind tibia length 0.70—0.78 and width 0.10—0.13, greatest pronotum width 0.55—0.60, postmentum length 0.53—0.63, greatest width 0.35—0.38. Major worker measurements (4 specimens, 3 colonies): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.15—1.23, greatest head width 1.00—1.10, postclypeal pad length 0.20 and width 0.40—0.43, greatest pronotum width 0.54—0.58, fore tibia length 0.55—0.60 and width 0.10, hind tibia length 0.63—0.70 and width 0.08—0.09. Soldier holotype from Mbala, Northern Province, Zambia, 23 December (month 12) 1969 (Bingham). The collection records are colonies from Macrotermes mounds in tall moist woodland and from under a piece of burnt wood.
